watch.en: Baste the food from time to time with butter, lard or oil.
watch.de: Das Gargut zwischendurch mit Butter, Schmalz oder Öl begießen.

why.en: Basting keeps the surface from losing moisture by evaporation.
why.de: Das Begießen verringert den Feuchtigkeitsverlust der Oberfläche durch Verdunstung.

sources.title: Culinary Foundations (Cheramie and Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: During roasting, meats and vegetables are frequently basted on the surface with butter, lard, or oil to reduce the loss of moisture by evaporation.
